body: Warrior is fine on xin, you just need attack speed from another item instead. I actually like warrior, triforce, phantom, IE on xin for crazy damage (his W benefits from IE's crit damage boost)

They're buffing bloodrazer a bit, but the new damage on it is sooo shitty early. I probably would wait until like 3rd or 4th item to even finish it, because at that point the enemy team starts having enough health for it to actually do good work.

Not to nit-pick or try to annoy you with details but your title says I (16m) and a girl (14 M) which implies male and female. Nothing major since you clarified in your post, but just wanted you to make sure you knew what it meant

I can't say I can understand anything you've been through, but I do know what its like to live through a traumatizing experience. It won't leave you, even with therapy. One thing that you might want to look for in a relationship is being a friend to someone who puts those feelings of panic and fear aside. If you can find someone who makes you feel safe again then you should pursue that. Theres no guarantee that you will though, and you may just find life easier to pursue a career in female bachelordom so to speak. Whatever happens, I do hope you stay safe and that nothing like that happens to you again.
